how: A downloadable benchmark application executing standardized LLM tasks through hardware-vendor execution paths, reporting tokens per second and latency.
name: MLPerf Client
note: The emerging reference for the local-AI PC market across Intel, AMD, Qualcomm, and NVIDIA silicon.
measures: On-device LLM inference performance on consumer hardware: laptops and desktops running local models through vendor acceleration stacks.
not_measured: Datacenter serving, model quality, or battery life in daily use; workloads are fixed prompts rather than your applications.
